L4 editorial line registry and source content

blocking_conflicts.fact: The DMIE/MMII master HTML bytes are not mounted.
blocking_conflicts.handling: Ship a strict adapter contract and source identity only; do not reconstruct the HTML.

blocking_conflicts.fact: Comet v1.4 inherits runtime and final deployment blocks from v1.3.
blocking_conflicts.handling: Keep the included HTML as a review candidate; no deployment claim.

blocking_conflicts.fact: The Comet v1.4 checksum list contains two self-referential checksum mismatches.
blocking_conflicts.handling: Generate a new non-self-referential manifest and disclose the inherited mismatch.

blocking_conflicts.fact: BOS v2 pipeline wording conflicts with the physical odd/even entry pattern.
blocking_conflicts.handling: Record physical pattern as PROVISIONAL and require Director approval.

blocking_conflicts.fact: BOS clinical color drifts between historical fuchsia and v2 blue-grey.
blocking_conflicts.handling: Use v2 blue-grey in the candidate and preserve the drift in the conflict register.

blocking_conflicts.fact: Bundle v3 and editorial line v4 use independent version namespaces.
blocking_conflicts.handling: Separate package_version from line_version in every schema.

blocking_conflicts.fact: RAG v3 is a governance source from a separate project boundary.
blocking_conflicts.handling: Reuse governance rules only; do not merge its unrelated content.

blocking_conflicts.fact: Prometheus and SELAH documents contain historical or unexecuted claims.
blocking_conflicts.handling: Use only orchestration/gate patterns; mark all runtime claims non-authoritative.

blocking_conflicts.fact: Self-Care/Journey v4 authored content is not available.
blocking_conflicts.handling: Create a spec-only candidate; do not fabricate entries.

blocking_conflicts.fact: Google Drive returned no relevant project evidence.
blocking_conflicts.handling: Keep Drive as a negative search result, not a source.
